issue.title: P4 Write batch can hang

repository.name: stratum
repository.description: Stratum is an open source silicon-independent switch operating system for software defined networks.

issue.body:
If you send a batch of writes to the P4Runtime Service, gRPC packs errors into the gRPC status response which goes into the HTTP2 header. If this response is sufficiently large (more than one TCP frame), then it will get split up into multiple HTTP2 continuation chunks.

The gRPC C++ server does not mark the original header correctly (with END_STREAM) if the header gets split into chunks, and as a result clients will hang indefinitely.

This problem can largely be avoid by using small write batches.

gRPC Issue:
https://github.com/grpc/grpc/issues/21436
